RBAC System – NestJS + Next.js
<p align="center"> <img src="data:image/png;base64," width="140"/> </p>
Overview

Production-ready Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) API built using NestJS (Backend) and Next.js (Frontend).

The system provides:

Secure authentication with JWT

Dynamic role and permission management

Protected REST APIs

Swagger API documentation

Modular scalable architecture

Tech Stack
Backend

NestJS

TypeScript

REST API

JWT Authentication

Swagger API Docs

Frontend

Next.js

React

Axios API integration

Installation
npm install
npm run start:dev

Server runs on:

http://localhost:3000

Swagger Docs:

http://localhost:3000/api
API Endpoints
DB_PORT=5432
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_PASSWORD=your_actual_password
Authentication APIs
Method	Endpoint	Description	Auth Required
POST	/auth/login	User login	❌
POST	/auth/refresh	Refresh access token	✔
GET	/auth/me	Get logged-in user info	✔
POST	/auth/logout	Logout user	✔
Users Module

Permission Required: view_users, manage_users

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/users	Get all users
POST	/users	Create new user
GET	/users/:id	Get single user
PATCH	/users/:id	Update user
DELETE	/users/:id	Delete user
User Permission Management
Method	Endpoint	Description
POST	/users/:id/assign-permissions	Assign permissions to user
POST	/users/:id/revoke-permissions	Remove permissions from user
Roles Module

Permission Required: view_roles, manage_roles

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/roles	List roles
POST	/roles	Create role
GET	/roles/:id	Get role
PATCH	/roles/:id	Update role
DELETE	/roles/:id	Delete role
Permissions Module

Permission Required: view_permissions, manage_permissions

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/permissions	Get all permission atoms
Leads Module

Permissions: view_leads, manage_leads

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/leads	Get leads
POST	/leads	Create lead
GET	/leads/:id	Get lead
PATCH	/leads/:id	Update lead
DELETE	/leads/:id	Delete lead
Tasks Module

Permissions: view_tasks, manage_tasks

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/tasks	Get tasks
POST	/tasks	Create task
PATCH	/tasks/:id	Update task
DELETE	/tasks/:id	Delete task
Reports Module

Permissions: view_reports

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/reports	Generate reports
Audit Logs

Permission: view_audit_logs

Method	Endpoint	Description
GET	/audit-logs	View system activity logs
RBAC Workflow

User logs in

JWT token generated

Token attached to API requests

Backend checks:

Role

Permissions

Access granted or denied

Error Responses
Status	Meaning
400	Bad Request
401	Unauthorized
403	Forbidden
429	Too Many Requests
